newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL--Goulds Pumps soars on deal.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL--Goulds Pumps soars on deal.

text.p: Investors bid up the stock of Goulds Pumps Inc in pre-open trade Monday after ITT Industries Inc agreed to acquire the company for $37 per share plus assumption of debt, traders said.
Goulds shares jumped to 35-15/16 in early third market trade, up from 22-7/8 at Friday's market close, they said.

Earlier this morning, the companies said both their boards approved a definitive agreement under which ITT Industries will acquire Goulds for $37 a share, or about $815 million, in cash, plus assumption of $119 million of Goulds' debt.
